text:
lena: Heads-up — noticed the console's per-route token graph spiked exactly when a bunch of clients reconnected this morning. Billing shows the same spike. I think preflight/resubscribe is counting attach twice. Anyone seen this pattern?

tom: yep saw that at 08:12 UTC. Our load test reproduced it when we force an OPTIONS preflight before WS upgrade. Dashboard + billing both jumped.

chi: interesting. IIRC we record a subscription attach in control-plane on the final upgrade handshake, but the proxy currently emits an 'attach' event when the preflight finishes too (we added it for early metrics). If both make it through, billing increments twice.

paul: we increment quota on the control-plane "attach" API and then emit usage to metering. If proxy sends a preflight attach then the real attach, metering will see two distinct attach ids. We don't dedupe by connection fingerprint.

lena: attaching a trimmed log where you can see the two attach calls back-to-back: ```
PROXY -> CP: POST /v1/attach {session_id: "tmp-xyz", route: "/stream"}
PROXY -> CP: POST /v1/attach {session_id: "sess-abc", route: "/stream"}
```

deploy-bot: deploy v3.14.2 to proxy (canary) finished at 2026-03-18T08:00:01Z :white_check_mark:

tom: potential fixes I see: 1) make attach idempotent server-side (reject if same client_fingerprint + route within short window), 2) stop emitting preflight attach, or 3) change metering to dedupe based on connection fingerprint + minute. Tradeoffs?

chi: 1) seems safest. We already have resume_id but preflight uses a temp id. If proxy propagated a stable fingerprint (e.g., tls_cert_fingerprint or a cookie) we could use that for idempotency. 2) might lose visibility for clients that never finish upgrade. 3) harder to guarantee correctness across regions, but quick for dashboards.

paul: idempotent attach in CP is doable. I'll add a short TTL store keyed by fingerprint+route. If a second attach arrives within 3s, return 200 but don't increment counters. Will need a migration for existing logs.

lena: can we also add a console annotation to mark periods where preflight metrics were enabled? That will help product understand why historical spikes appear.

tom: +1. I'll add an annotation and a temporary dashboard panel showing "unique session keys" vs "attach events" to highlight duplicates.

chi: one more caveat — some browsers do Upgrade followed by immediate fallback to SSE (no WS). That path legitimately triggers two different attach semantics (one for preflight, one for SSE). Need to ensure we don't drop legitimate double-counts for real separate connections.

paul: good call. We'll make the idempotency use a high-entropy fingerprint AND require identical transport type to dedupe (ws vs sse). That should avoid collapsing distinct upgrades.

lena: created a quick issue and assigned: paul -> implement attach idempotency; tom -> dashboard annotation + panel; chi -> run e2e with preflight toggles; I'll own followup with billing to reconcile the yesterday spike. :spiral_notepad:

deploy-bot: created issue INF-2412 (attach idempotency) and linked to this thread.

tom: estimate: paul ~2d, tom ~1d, chi ~1d for tests. If acceptable, we can patch proxy canary today and roll CP change tomorrow.

lena: sounds good. Also note we should add a small telemetry counter for "preflight_attach_emitted" so we can flip it off quickly if noisy.

paul: will include that metric in PR.

lena: thanks all. If anyone finds more dupes, drop logs here. :thumbsup:
